clock_definition.FY: ISZE financial year April to March, labelled by the closing year (FY2026 = Apr 2025 to Mar 2026)

limit: The EPC gives vehicle FAMILY, not tonnage. TRUCKS N spans NLR to NQR, so 3.5 t and 7.5 t are NOT separated here. A tonnage band needs the model-code table.
Only the part numbers in EPC batch 1 are covered — the top 250 by value. Everything else is absent rather than zero.
A part fitting more than one family is pooled as 'shared_across_families' and is NOT apportioned, because apportioning would be an assumption.
